# portainer_kubernetes_storage_class (Data Source)

Inspects one storage class.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_kubernetes_storage_class" "fast" {
  endpoint_id = portainer_environment.prod.id
  name        = "fast-ssd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (Number) Identifier of the Kubernetes environment to query.
- `name` (String) Name of the storage class to inspect.

### Read-Only

- `allow_volume_expansion` (Boolean) Whether volumes of this class can be grown after they are created.
- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on the storage class.
- `creation_date` (String) When the storage class was created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the cluster's default storage class.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the storage class.
- `mount_options` (List of String) Mount options applied to volumes of this class.
- `parameters` (Map of String) Provisioner-specific parameters of the class.
- `provisioner_name` (String) Provisioner backing the storage class.
- `reclaim_policy` (String) What happens to a volume when its claim is released, for example `Delete` or `Retain`.

## Attributes Reference

`allow_volume_expansion` is what decides whether an existing claim of this class can be resized later.
